```{r, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE}
source(here::here("_rinit.R"))
invisible(Sys.setlocale("LC_TIME", "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
invisible(Sys.setenv(TZ = "Europe/Paris"))

retraites <- tribble(
  ~source, ~dataset,
  "insee",  "DECES-MORTALITE",
  "ipp",  "revalorisation_pension") %>%
  arrange(source, dataset)
```

# Espérance de vie

## Tous

```{r}
ig_d("insee", "DECES-MORTALITE", "esperance-vie")
```

## 1981-

```{r}
ig_d("insee", "DECES-MORTALITE", "esperance-vie-1981")
```

## Par CSP

```{r}
ig_b("insee", "ip2005", "fig3")
```
